open_items: First GUI-driven attempt (e5, 2026-11-05) ended NO-GO: available RAM fell from 8.7 GB to 2.63 GB while Forge cold-loaded the checkpoint, against the then 6 GB floor.

Second, third and fourth attempts (e7, e9, e10, 2 GB floor) passed functionally and on safety. e7 had the checkpoint resident; e9 switched checkpoints and dipped to 5.73 GB; e10 loaded the checkpoint into an empty GPU and dipped to 5.84 GB. The original 6 GB floor would have failed e9 and e10; the first attempt's empty-GPU load fell to 2.63 GB. The load-time RAM minimum varies across runs (2.63, 5.73, 5.84 GB) and every run is a single run at smoke settings.

Both images were reviewed as observations (closeout record 2.2 and 8): over-saturated and noisy at 512x512 / 6 steps, the second shows a legible lighthouse. No quality verdict; the quality dimension stays NOT TESTED.

The attempts dispatched schedulers 'Normal' (e5, e9, e10), 'automatic' (e7) under the same frozen plan; the plan does not freeze the scheduler and the cause is not established (the 'no registry evidence' status was the same in all runs).

Owner decision e8: dimensions stay as declared. Any dimension change after the four attempts (for example resource, or integration to QUALIFIED) is a proposal in the closeout record and has not been accepted.
